metadata.title: Dactinomycin for low-risk GTN
metadata.indication: An alternative after methotrexate resistance in low-risk GTN (FIGO score 6 or below) when hCG is below 1,000 IU/L.
metadata.partial_assessment_note: Any independently actionable entered value is assessed; omitted domains remain unassessed and do not block a partial result.
metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Use the most restrictive applicable component rule and confirm all dose changes against the current official NCCP PDF.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding derived from NCCP 00247 Version 4. It does not replace the current official regimen, prescribing review, pharmacy verification or independent clinical judgement.

indications.description: An alternative after methotrexate resistance in low-risk GTN (FIGO score 6 or below) when hCG is below 1,000 IU/L.

treatment.schedule_summary: The nurse gives dactinomycin into a vein once every two weeks. Tell the nurse at once if the line stings. After hCG normalises the plan includes three more cycles.
